summary: Frees a global collision-geometry linked list. First walks the list with StringCompareLinkedListSearch on each node's data pointer (node+0), advancing through next pointers (node+4). Then walks again freeing every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf, additionally freeing the node's data payload (via EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf) when the ownership byte at node+8 is non-zero and the data pointer is non-null. Finally zeroes the four collision globals dword_7CDDF0/7CDDF4/7CDDF8/7CDDFC. Returns immediately when the list head is null.

operations.description: Copy list head dword_7CDDF0 into iterator dword_7CDDF8.
If list head dword_7CDDF0 is null, skip both walks and jump to the zeroing tail.

First walk: while data at the current node (node+0) and the iterator dword_7CDDF8 are non-null, call StringCompareLinkedListSearch on the node data pointer and advance dword_7CDDF8 through the next pointer at node+4.
Second walk: iterate every node via the next pointer at node+4, reading the ownership byte at node+8.
For nodes whose ownership byte at node+8 is non-zero and whose data pointer at node+0 is non-null, call EmptyStub_7470(data) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(data).
Free every node allocation with FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four collision globals: dword_7CDDF0, dword_7CDDF4, dword_7CDDF8 and dword_7CDDFC.
